summary: Methanex filed a Form 6-K containing a Canadian Form 51-102F3 material change report disclosing board approval, announced October 29, 2026, of a Normal Course Issuer Bid (the Canadian equivalent of a US share repurchase program). The Company may buy back and cancel up to 3,868,213 common shares, roughly 5% of the 77,364,263 shares outstanding as of October 29, 2026. Purchases run November 4, 2026 through no later than November 3, 2027, on NASDAQ and US alternative trading systems at then-current market prices under Rule 10b-18, capped at 25% of average daily volume with block-purchase exceptions, and executed via an automatic securities purchase plan with its broker. Watch actual execution pace versus the 5% authorization, which signals management's capital-return conviction.
